On 9/8/12 9:55 PM, Daniel Lee wrote:
> Looks like some of our other cdf functions aren't ready.

Is the issue is that we need to be able to auto-dif
not just the variate, but also the params?

Boost only templates on a single parameter, so their
CDF isn't enough.

According to Wikipedia, we need an incomplete gamma
function for the gamma distribution.

At least the Weibull cdf has a simple analytic form.

- Bob
